currentSprint.name: Vertical Slice 01 — Christian and The Dreamer

workstreams.name: Independent baseline audit
workstreams.largestGap: Fresh critic scored visual shipping readiness 2.8/10; authored hero and world-scale environment art are largest gap.

workstreams.name: Christian protagonist
workstreams.critic: fresh visual critic — fail, 3.0/10 on v11
workstreams.largestGap: The burden reads as a rigid board and the body remains an 8,694-triangle procedural blockout; target is an authored 19–24k sculpt with real LODs, cloth compression, and readable face/anatomy.

workstreams.name: The Dreamer environment
workstreams.largestGap: Dream guided travel now uses monotonic authored bends, every clearing is reachable, and the medium collision runtime is mounted. The remaining gap is visual: the shrine, vegetation, and water still need a stronger focal hierarchy and authored asset fidelity.

workstreams.name: The Wicket Gate authored beat
workstreams.critic: fresh live critic — fail, visual bar; gameplay contract now passes
workstreams.largestGap: The six beats now share real gate anchors, animated leaves/bolts, Goodwill reveal, entry bounds, and telegraphed swept arrows; the desktop arrow-impact and full traversal suites are green. The remaining gap is authored rendering quality: low-poly masonry/vegetation, flat path, and weak material depth versus the keyframe bar.

workstreams.name: Performance and loading
workstreams.largestGap: Current Gate benchmark reaches scene-ready in 5.60s desktop / 4.44s mobile at 3.8 / 6.6 headless FPS, with 124 / 88 draw-call p95 and 33,786 / 29,582 triangle p95. Mobile draw count is now under 100; hardware FPS, cold-start variance, and authored visual fidelity remain release blockers.

workstreams.name: Live progress board
workstreams.largestGap: Lazyweb MCP tools are unavailable in this task; data feed is live, visual board awaits connector refresh.
